descs.en: The clingiest psychology student alive dates the coldest criminal profiler in the city. Then she finds the notebook where he records her.

ideaNote: Planned: 50 chapters. The Seminar · The Notebook · The Profile · The Partner · Side stories.

synopsis.title: Synopsis
synopsis.content:
Yen Si-Jie sat in the front row of a criminal-psychology seminar with hearts in her eyes while everyone else was frightened of the guest lecturer. Arthur Cheung profiles the city’s worst people for a living. He agreed to date her because she was the only person he’d ever met who didn’t hide her motives.

She sends twenty texts in a row. She sits on his lap while he reads case files. Then she finds his notebook, full of her moods and reactions in neat columns.

Is she his girlfriend or his experiment? And why is his newest case circling closer to her?

Sunshine and the cold one · Clingy heroine · A profiler in love · Coming soon

authorNote.title: Author Note
authorNote.content:
Arthur’s notebook isn’t creepy. It’s his clumsy way of learning how to love someone, because nobody ever taught him. ‘I’m not studying you. I’m learning you.’

It’s playful and intense, with a thriller running under a sweet romance. The man who reads everyone can’t read her in bed, and she makes him say what he wants.

characters.title: Characters

chars.name: Yen Si-Jie
chars.appearance: Always attached to his arm; a photo album of him looking grumpy.
chars.personality:
The middle triplet, unapologetically obsessed
Uses attachment theory to justify texting him twenty times
Fears she’s only a variable to him
chars.strengths:
Reads people’s feelings instantly
Braver than anyone gives her credit for
chars.weaknesses:
Needs to be the centre of his world
Will pay her dignity for his attention
chars.favHabit: ‘I’m not clingy. I’m practising anxious-preoccupied attachment.’

chars.name: Arthur Cheung
chars.role: Male Lead · criminal profiler and guest lecturer
chars.appearance: Cold, precise, a gaze that makes people feel read; a black notebook in his inside pocket.
chars.personality:
An analytical kind of quiet
Raised by a judge and a forensic pathologist
Has no idea how to feel things without writing them down
chars.strengths:
Narrows a suspect list like nobody else
Notices her heart rate before she does
chars.weaknesses:
Treats love as data
Jealous, and calls it caution
chars.favHabit: ‘I’m not studying you. I’m learning you.’

chars.name: Eliana Lin
chars.personality: Came to understand the darkness for her work; got dragged into the triplets’ lives instead

chars.name: Yang Pengcheng
chars.personality: Arthur’s least favourite person at every dinner party since childhood

contentWarn.title: Content Warning

Planned content includes:

• Violent crime and criminal profiling

• Stalking, and a case that targets the heroine

• Anxious attachment, handled with care
